column1: # UnitType FIELDS (kind F): owner <TAB> F <TAB> old <TAB> type descriptor <TAB> new
# The 16 renamed fields are exactly the rows of ModLoader.ALIASES, whose meaning doc 17 derived
# from the getters. The new names are the ALIASES semantic keys on purpose, so after this batch
# a JSON key and the Java field share one name and ALIASES only has to keep the legacy letters
# working (see the atomic ModLoader/ModFieldAliasTest update in the same commit).
# Every field here is private, so the blast radius is UnitType.java itself plus the two
# reflective users. Case matters: D is the float sight range and d the String name, H is the
# capacity and h the building flag - a case-insensitive lookup would silently swap them.
# Left blank: a/b (type list + damage matrix), c (id), o (computed vertical offset), p/q (flag
# bits), u (salvo), v, w/x/y/z/A/B/C/E/F/G/I/J - doc 17 records these as unconfirmed.
